output.summary: Enjoys mind-bending sci-fi narratives with deep themes and strong directorial vision.

candidates.title: Branded
candidates.overview: In a dystopian future, where corporate brands have created a disillusioned population, one man's effort to unlock the truth behind the conspiracy leads to an epic battle with hidden forces that control the world.

candidates.title: The Green Mile
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Director: Frank Darabont → The Green Mile
candidates.overview: A supernatural tale set on death row in a Southern prison, where gentle giant John Coffey possesses the mysterious power to heal people's ailments. When the cell block's head guard, Paul Edgecomb, recognizes Coffey's miraculous gift, he tries desperately to help stave off the condemned man's execution.

candidates.title: Altered States
candidates.overview: A research scientist explores the boundaries and frontiers of consciousness. Using sensory deprivation and hallucinogenic mixtures from native American shamans, he explores these altered states of consciousness and finds that memory, time, and perhaps reality itself are states of mind.

candidates.title: The Mist
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Director: Frank Darabont → The Mist
candidates.overview: After a violent storm, a dense cloud of mist envelops a small Maine town, trapping artist David Drayton and his five-year-old son in a local grocery store with other people. They soon discover that the mist conceals deadly horrors that threaten their lives, and worse, their sanity.

candidates.title: Parallels
candidates.overview: An underground MMA fighter must confront his sister and his past in an adventure through parallel universes

candidates.title: The Majestic
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Director: Frank Darabont → The Majestic
candidates.overview: Set in 1951, a blacklisted Hollywood writer gets into a car accident, loses his memory and settles down in a small town where he is mistaken for a long-lost son.

candidates.title: Scanners
candidates.overview: After a man with extraordinary—and frighteningly destructive—telepathic abilities is nabbed by agents from a mysterious rogue corporation, he discovers he is far from the only possessor of such strange powers, and that some of the other “scanners” have their minds set on world domination, while others are trying to stop them.

candidates.title: Django Unchained
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Django Unchained
candidates.overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.

candidates.title: Terminus
candidates.overview: Following a near-fatal accident, David Chamberlain makes an unprecedented discovery that will not only determine the fate of his family, but of mankind.

candidates.title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
candidates.overview: An assassin is shot and almost killed by her ruthless employer, Bill, and other members of their assassination circle – but she lives to plot her vengeance.  Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair is a complete edit of the two-part martial arts action films Kill Bill: Vol. 1 and Kill Bill: Vol. 2. The film was originally scheduled to be released as one part. However, due to the film's over 4 hour running time, it was split into two parts.

candidates.title: The Beyond
candidates.overview: Set in 2019, The Beyond chronicles the groundbreaking mission which sent astronauts - modified with advanced robotics, through a newly discovered wormhole known as the Void. When the mission returns unexpectedly, the space agency races to discover what the astronauts encountered on their first of its kind interstellar space journey.

candidates.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Kill Bill: Vol. 2
candidates.overview: The Bride unwaveringly continues on her roaring rampage of revenge against the band of assassins who had tried to kill her and her unborn child. She visits each of her former associates one-by-one, checking off the victims on her Death List Five until there's nothing left to do … but kill Bill.

candidates.title: Infinite
candidates.overview: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves “Infinites” come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

candidates.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Kill Bill: Vol. 1
candidates.overview: An assassin is shot by her ruthless employer, Bill, and other members of their assassination circle – but she lives to plot her vengeance.

candidates.title: Interstellar
candidates.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel and conquer the vast distances involved in an interstellar voyage.

candidates.title: Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood
candidates.overview: Los Angeles, 1969. TV star Rick Dalton, a struggling actor specializing in westerns, and stuntman Cliff Booth, his best friend, try to survive in a constantly changing movie industry. Dalton is the neighbor of the young and promising actress and model Sharon Tate, who has just married the prestigious Polish director Roman Polanski…

candidates.title: The Abyss
candidates.overview: A civilian oil rig crew is recruited to conduct a search and rescue effort when a nuclear submarine mysteriously sinks. One diver soon finds himself on a spectacular odyssey 25,000 feet below the ocean's surface where he confronts a mysterious force that has the power to change the world or destroy it.

candidates.title: The Glimmer Man
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Cast: Bob Gunton → The Glimmer Man
candidates.overview: A former government operative renowned for his stealth, Jack Cole is now a Los Angeles police detective. When a series of horrible murders occurs in the metro area, Cole is assigned to the case, along with tough-talking fellow cop Jim Campbell. Although the two men clash, they gradually become effective partners as they uncover a conspiracy linked to the killings, which also involves terrorism and organized crime.

candidates.title: Prometheus
candidates.overview: A team of explorers discover a clue to the origins of mankind on Earth, leading them on a journey to the darkest corners of the universe. There, they must fight a terrifying battle to save the future of the human race.

candidates.title: Jackie Brown
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Jackie Brown
candidates.overview: Jackie Brown is a flight attendant who gets caught in the middle of smuggling cash into the country for her gunrunner boss. When the cops try to use Jackie to get to her boss, she hatches a plan — with help from a bail bondsman — to keep the money for herself.

candidates.title: Dreamscape
candidates.overview: A government funded project looks into using psychics to enter people's dreams, with some mechanical help. When a subject dies in their sleep from a heart attack, Alex Gardner becomes suspicious that another of the psychics is killing people in the dreams somehow and that is causing them to die in real life. He must find a way to stop the abuse of the power to enter dreams.

candidates.title: The Hateful Eight
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → The Hateful Eight
candidates.overview: Bounty hunters seek shelter from a raging blizzard and get caught up in a plot of betrayal and deception.

candidates.title: The Butterfly Effect
candidates.overview: A young man struggles to access sublimated childhood memories. He finds a technique that allows him to travel back into the past, to occupy his childhood body and change history. However, he soon finds that every change he makes has unexpected consequences.

candidates.title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Theme: briefcase → Roman J. Israel, Esq.
candidates.overview: Hard-nosed liberal lawyer Roman J. Israel has been fighting the good fight forever while others take the credit. When his partner – the firm's frontman – has a heart attack, Israel suddenly takes on that role. He soon discovers some unsettling truths about the firm – truths that conflict with his values of helping the poor and dispossessed – and finds himself in an existential crisis that leads to extreme actions.

candidates.title: Possessor
candidates.overview: Tasya Vos, an elite corporate assassin, uses brain-implant technology to take control of other people’s bodies to terminate high profile targets. As she sinks deeper into her latest assignment, Vos becomes trapped inside a mind that threatens to obliterate her.

candidates.title: Out of the Past
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Theme: briefcase → Out of the Past
candidates.overview: Jeff Bailey seems to be a mundane gas station owner in remote Bridgeport, California. He is dating local girl Ann Miller and lives a quiet life. But Jeff has a secret past, and when a mysterious stranger arrives in town, Jeff is forced to return to the dark world he had tried to escape.

candidates.title: Robot Overlords
candidates.overview: Earth has been conquered by robots from another galaxy and the human survivors must stay in their homes, or risk incineration.

candidates.title: Unknown
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Theme: briefcase → Unknown
candidates.overview: A man awakens from a coma, only to discover that someone has taken on his identity and that no one, (not even his wife), believes him. With the help of a young woman, he sets out to prove who he is.

candidates.title: Phenomenon
candidates.overview: An ordinary man sees a bright light descend from the sky, and discovers he now has super-intelligence and telekinesis.

candidates.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Cast: Bob Gunton → Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
candidates.overview: Summoned from an ashram in Tibet, Ace finds himself on a perilous journey into the jungles of Africa to find Shikaka, the missing sacred animal of the friendly Wachati tribe. He must accomplish this before the wedding of the Wachati's Princess to the prince of the warrior Wachootoos. If Ace fails, the result will be a vicious tribal war.

candidates.title: Aliens
candidates.overview: When Ripley's lifepod is found by a salvage crew over 50 years later, she finds that terra-formers are on the very planet they found the alien species. When the company sends a family of colonists out to investigate her story—all contact is lost with the planet and colonists. They enlist Ripley and the colonial marines to return and search for answers.

candidates.title: 24: Redemption
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Cast: Bob Gunton → 24: Redemption
candidates.overview: Former federal agent Jack Bauer confronts African dictator Benjamin Juma, whose forces have been ordered to capture the children Bauer oversees for malicious military training.

candidates.title: Doctor Strange
candidates.overview: Dr. Stephen Strange embarks on a wondrous journey to the heights of a Tibetan mountain, where he seeks healing at the feet of the mysterious Ancient One.

candidates.title: Bats
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Cast: Bob Gunton → Bats
candidates.overview: Genetically mutated bats escape and it's up to a bat expert and the local sheriff to stop them.

candidates.title: Science Fiction Volume One: The Osiris Child
candidates.overview: Set in the future in a time of interplanetary colonization, an unlikely pair race against an impending global crisis and are confronted by the monsters that live inside us all.

candidates.title: Patch Adams
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Cast: Bob Gunton → Patch Adams
candidates.overview: The true story of Dr. Hunter "Patch" Adams, who in the 1970s found that humor is the best medicine, and was willing to do just anything to make his patients laugh—even if it meant risking his own career.

candidates.title: Chronicle
candidates.overview: Three high school students make an incredible discovery, leading to their developing uncanny powers beyond their understanding. As they learn to control their abilities and use them to their advantage, their lives start to spin out of control, and their darker sides begin to take over.

candidates.title: Dead Silence
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Cast: Bob Gunton → Dead Silence
candidates.overview: Jamie returns to his hometown in search of answers to his wife's murder, which occurred after receiving a weird package containing a ventriloquist dummy named Billy, which may be linked to the legend of ventriloquist Mary Shaw. Destined to find out the truth, Jamie goes to the town of Raven's Fair, where Shaw used to perform and is buried. But Jamie is in for more than he expected.

candidates.title: Extracted
candidates.overview: Thomas Jacobs invents a way to watch people's memories from the inside. Going against his morals, he accepts an offer to enter a heroin addict's memories to literally see if he committed a crime. However,a malfunction causes his consciousness to become trapped inside the criminal's mind. He remains a prisoner in the addict's memories for more than four years until he discovers the possibility of escape.

candidates.title: Tramps
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Theme: briefcase → Tramps
candidates.overview: A young man and woman find love in an unlikely place while carrying out a shady deal.

candidates.title: Revolt
candidates.overview: The story of humankind's last stand against a cataclysmic alien invasion. Set in the war-ravaged African countryside, a U.S. soldier and a French foreign aid worker team up to survive the alien onslaught. Their bond will be tested as they search for refuge across a crumbling world.

candidates.title: The Departed
candidates.path: Shutter Island → Director: Martin Scorsese → The Departed
candidates.overview: To take down South Boston's Irish Mafia, the police send in one of their own to infiltrate the underworld, not realizing the syndicate has done likewise. While an undercover cop curries favor with the mob kingpin, a career criminal rises through the police ranks. But both sides soon discover there's a mole among them.

candidates.title: Replicas
candidates.overview: A scientist becomes obsessed with returning his family to normalcy after a terrible accident.

candidates.title: Die Hard 2
candidates.path: The Shawshank Redemption → Cast: William Sadler → Die Hard 2
candidates.overview: Off-duty cop John McClane is gripped with a feeling of déjà vu when, on a snowy Christmas Eve in the nation’s capital, terrorists seize a major international airport, holding thousands of holiday travelers hostage. Renegade military commandos led by a murderous rogue officer plot to rescue a drug lord from justice and are prepared for every contingency except one: McClane’s smart-mouthed heroics.

candidates.title: The Cloverfield Paradox
candidates.overview: Orbiting above a planet on the brink of war, scientists test a device to solve an energy crisis and end up face-to-face with a dark alternate reality.

candidates.title: Reservoir Dogs
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Reservoir Dogs
candidates.overview: A botched robbery indicates a police informant, and the pressure mounts in the aftermath at a warehouse. Crime begets violence as the survivors -- veteran Mr. White, newcomer Mr. Orange, psychopathic parolee Mr. Blonde, bickering weasel Mr. Pink and Nice Guy Eddie -- unravel.

candidates.title: Surrogates
candidates.overview: Set in a futuristic world where humans live in isolation and interact through surrogate robots, a cop is forced to leave his home for the first time in years in order to investigate the murders of others' surrogates.

candidates.title: Inglourious Basterds
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Inglourious Basterds
candidates.overview: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.

candidates.title: Transcendence
candidates.overview: Two leading computer scientists work toward their goal of Technological Singularity,  as a radical anti-technology organization fights to prevent them from creating a world where computers can transcend the abilities of the human brain.

candidates.title: Reservoir Dogs
candidates.path: Pulp Fiction → Director: Quentin Tarantino → Reservoir Dogs
candidates.overview: Short film made with the help of the Sundance Film Institute and serving as a proof-of-concept for the subsequent feature film.
